workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.closeAllDescription: This closes documents in every group, including collapsed groups. Pinned or protected documents can prevent closing. Unsaved changes still require confirmation.
workspace.closeAllHint: Documents · Keeps the layout and asks for confirmation
workspace.findEntry: Find a page or plugin entry

layout.label: Layout
layout.resetMenu: Restore default layout (close documents and reload)

keyboard.label: Keyboard shortcuts
keyboard.title: Workspace keyboard shortcuts
keyboard.note: Workspace shortcuts ignore text fields. You can still open the command palette while typing. Arrow keys follow the focus rules of tabs and menus.
keyboard.palette: Open the command palette to find pages, plugin entries, and workspace commands
keyboard.result: Move between palette results. Press Enter to run the selected result.
keyboard.sidebar: Show or hide the left navigation
keyboard.closeActive: Close the active document, respecting pinned tabs and unsaved changes
keyboard.previous: Activate the previous document in layout order
keyboard.next: Activate the next document in layout order
keyboard.maximize: Maximize or restore the active document group
keyboard.menu: Open the menu for the focused tab, group, or container
keyboard.focusContent: Move focus between the selected tab and its content
keyboard.focusGroup: Focus the next or previous tab container
